english: Big trouble, nyo!!\nA letter from Eve arrived, nyo!
What? This is Dokoka Town, you know?
So there was a kind mailman or something?
Don't be stupid.\nEve delivered it herself.\nShe's capable of that much.
Going out of her way to do something so roundabout…\nI wonder what the reason is? I wonderr
She's going to slowly wear us down and corner us.\nPsychologically and physically.
Dejiko, what's in the letter?
It's got the next battlefield and the date and time written on it, nyo.\nNyo-nyo!? We're almost out of time, nyo!!
This is bad... The wounded won't recover\nin time.
I've finished the first-aid rounds, but\nthere are girls who just can't fight right now.
First of all, unless we figure out a way to beat Eve,\nfighting her is pointless.
Quite right. [MERU],\ntell me everything you know about Eve.\nWhy does she revive no matter how often she's struck down?
Quite right. [NOEL],\ntell me everything you know about Eve.\nWhy does she revive no matter how often she's struck down?
I don't really know... But\nthat wasn't an illusion -\nI'm sure the one we fought was the real teacher.
That revival trick was a first for me too.\nSo I don't know. What I do know is\nthe one we fought was the teacher herself.
So she gets tired, and\nshe takes damage too, is that it?
Probably... It's the first time I've even seen\nthe teacher fight for real, so\nI don't really know what moves she uses.
But the one we fought was the teacher.\nThe moment we thought we'd beaten her she vanished,\nand the one who came back was the teacher herself.
The teacher loves fighting, y'know.\nShe doesn't get many chances\nto use all her moves and spells.
She went down and vanished a few times, but\nthe one we were fighting was the real teacher the whole time.
You can tell something like that?
My magical yoyo is\none of magical archaeology's discoveries too, so\nI can tell the moment magical power is used.
My Magical Magic is\none of magical archaeology's discoveries too, so\nI can tell the moment magical power is used.
So the principle is the same?
Yes. If the teacher used a power\ndifferent from my magical yoyo,\neven I wouldn't be able to tell...
Right! It was the same magical power!
So at least, last time you fought her,\nshe was fighting with a power\neven you could sense.
That's right.
Same magical power being used,\ndifferent spells - that about sum it up?\nMaybe Ms. Louise could tell?
I see. It's like the difference between\nExplosion and Illusion within Void magic -\nnowhere near the gap between Void magic and spirit magic.
Then there's only one way to play it.
Oh? And what's that?
A blitz, okay? We don't let her use any spells or moves -\nwe just keep piling on until she breaks...!
Exactly.\nGive her time to do anything and\nit only puts us at a disadvantage.
Not exactly a brilliant plan.
But stacked against Eve,\nour advantage is sheer volume of attacks.\nThe blitz is a sound plan.
If we treat her as a mage,\ndenying her time to cast is textbook.
If we take any more wounded,\nthings get even tougher.\nWe want to avoid a long battle.
Decided! Round up everyone who can fight -\nwe're moving out!
Heeey, Kei-chan.\nWhy d'you think Eve-chin\nwants to kill her disciples herselff?
Unknown.
Huh? It's not 'cannot comprehend' today?
Data required for verification: insufficient.\nConclusion: unknown.
I seee.\nEve's hiding something, huhh.
Do you want the data?
Kei-chan, you still don't get it, huh.\nSpoilers are the most un-fun thing ever!
Then... shall I investigate\nEve's reason for killing her disciples?
Geez, Kei-chan,\nthat's such a boring amateur way to think.\nMii's different!
Mii's a king, y'know!\nI'll do the things only a king can do!\nThat's what's fun!
Unable... to comprehend?
This is the designated spot!
And the time should be right.
So you've come.
There she is!!
Sorry, but no talking this time!\nLet's go, everyone!
Let's do this!!
The show's on hold today!
So you mean to swarm me.\nThe standard tactic against a spellcaster.
We overwhelm her with numbers and give her no time!\nIt won't go like last time!
I see. Then I too\nshall increase my numbers.
Our turn at last!
[NOEL]!
You can't just forget about us, okay!
It's our turn!
[MERU]!
We won't let you pull off any blitz!
Two more? That's nothing!\nWe've still got the numbers!
Indeed. Quite the problem.
This really was the right way to attack!
Numbers... Very well. I shall multiply.
'Multiply'? Not 'increase'...?
Hmph!
What!?
No way!?
They're illusions! Beat the real one and the rest should disappear!
Don't confuse me\nwith such childish tricks.
Huh...?
I said I would multiply.\nBut not to increase targets\nand scatter your attacks.
Every one of them is me -\na means to thicken my numbers, my attacks.\nDo try not to misunderstand.
All of these are Eve...?\nThat can't be!\nThat's just not possible!
Judging others by your own common sense is dangerous.\nLouise the Zero.
Teacher...!
Teacher...!
Come at me.\nThere is no escape.
We got her!
Not bad. Keep it up.
...You've got to be kidding.
...That's cheating.
Don't be so surprised.\nJust strike me down again.
Or think of it this way:\nhow many more must fall before it ends?
That, I'm afraid I can't tell you.
This is bad - at this rate...!
Just keep taking them down!\nIt's all we can do!
That's it. Strike down more. Fufufu...!
You're rotten!
Wh-wh-what do we do...?
Taking down even one of her is hard enough!
Isn't there some plan!?
With this many of her,\nthere's nothing we can do...!
[NOEL]!\nYou mean to kill me too!?
I just follow the teacher.
I thought so...\nYou won't tell me the reason...?
That's not for me to say.
[MERU]!\nWhy are you trying to kill me!
It's what the teacher decided.
What do YOU think about it, [MERU]?
Now's not the time to say!
[MERU]! Something's wrong with you, [MERU]!
Nothing's wrong with me!!
Forgive me, teacher... I was no use...
I lost...
Enough. Fall back and rest.
Yes.
Yes.
Doesn't feel like things got\nany better at all...
At least they don't revive!\nFocus on Eve!
Teacher! Is there any meaning to this fight?
That's not for you to think about.
Teacher! I'll strike you down again and again and again!
Then try.
This looks like your limit.
Not... not yet...!!
What could you do with what magic you have left?\nAnd look - your comrades no longer\nhave the strength to keep fighting.
How...! Why do you go after everyone\ninstead of killing me!?
If you're going to do it, kill me!\nWhy go after everyone else!
You misunderstand\nthe meaning of the word 'kill'.
You seem to think stopping\nlife functions counts as killing -\ndo you really think it's that simple?
I'll say it once more. I will kill you.\nIn my own way.
Sonico, hurry!\nThere are still so many injured!
Right! Medicine, bandages...\nAnd this too...!
Water first! Hot water if you can!
Hot water, got it!
Hardly anyone's unhurt anymore.\nWe've got to do something...
I'm sorry...
I'm sorry...
Nothing to apologize for.\nWe've all been fighting\ntogether this whole time.
That won't change.\nEveryone feels the same.
Shirayuki...
Shirayuki...
But sheesh, this is badd.\nIf we just keep taking hits like this,\nhow long can we hold out...?
We'll strike back, nyu!
A surprise attack would be difficult.\nEve has no openings.
Did you try sniping her?
Yes. But, just as a feeling,\nI don't think I could hit Eve even if I sniped her.
'Don't think you could hit her'...?
And even if I did hit her, if she'd\njust revive like before,\nit would be meaningless.
Geez! How are we supposed to beat her!?
Perhaps we have to change our thinking.
You got an idea, nyu?
I have no basis for it, but...\nnot trying to win, for example.
(Not trying to win...?)
(Not trying to win...?)
